note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online, Kansas DASC/ORKA statewide services (services.kansasgis.org, mapserver.kansasgis.org, services.kgs.ku.edu), county website pages and third-party directories. The Kansas ORKA extras service has only partial statewide layers (address points, subdivisions, lots, AGUSE land-use polygons) with no parcel polygon layer for Cheyenne County. Parcel access is through the ORKA viewer and a PORKA request process, not a public queryable service. Only commercial vendors (Regrid, Acres, Rockford Map) offer Cheyenne parcels. No county-hosted parcel REST service was found.
